entries.label: Local memory
entries.text: Craft workers held free lessons in mending ordinary tools. Local households mark lent tools with a removable strip of cloth.

entries.label: Local memory
entries.text: Craft workers held free lessons in mending ordinary tools. Local households show apprentices the first stitch in an old household cloth.

entries.label: Local memory
entries.text: Carters shared a cart during repairs to several broken axles. Local households sweep a neighbour's hearth when they cannot do it.
